subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should maintainers accept replacing Node fs.glob with this internal yielding workspace walker for bootstrap-extra-files before merge?
rationale: The patch fixes a real P1 stall and avoids public SDK changes, but green CI cannot prove every existing glob pattern, workspace layout, or ordering assumption across upgrades.

options.title: Accept With Exact-Head Gates
options.body: Land this PR once required checks finish because the branch preserves public SDK signatures and covers the main glob compatibility hazards with focused tests.

options.title: Require Broader Live Proof
options.body: Ask for one end-to-end embedded_run or channel-connected liveness transcript on a large workspace before accepting the custom walker replacement.

options.title: Pause The Walker Direction
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers prefer an upstream fs.glob mitigation or a narrower diagnostic-only fix over custom core traversal.

recommendation.title: Accept With Exact-Head Gates
recommendation.body: Land this PR once required checks finish because the branch preserves public SDK signatures and covers the main glob compatibility hazards with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The history trail points to prior ownership of the bootstrap read and internal hook contracts, which are the compatibility decision surfaces here.
